issues.claim: "Edison Pediatrics and Adult Medicine (Advocare)" and "Edison Pediatrics / HNR Pediatrics (Medical Group of NJ)"
issues.problem: Both exist in Edison (verified 1740 Oak Tree Rd Suite B, (732) 515-5590; and 34-36 Progress St Suite A1, (908) 561-5700), but both carry larger network branding rather than a purely local name. Advocare is a several-hundred-provider physician network, which a strict reading of the chain rule could exclude.
issues.fix: Confirm with the client whether network-affiliated but independently owned practices are in scope; if not, drop or segregate these.
